title: Mconet JsonPayload
description: Language-neutral erased JSON payload containing a semantic type identifier, an optional schema identifier, and one recursive JSON value.
$comment: Copyright © 2026 Mcont. This self-contained Schema is the serializable shape of the codec-json JsonPayload contract. It does not encode, decode, select a media type, choose a component, or authorize a request. TypeScript readonly ownership has no JSON representation. An omitted schemaId means no schema was declared; null is not a substitute. Unknown members are retained and must not drive codec or component selection.

typeId.description: Semantic identity preserved from the protocol adapter output port.

schemaId.description: Optional schema identity preserved beside the JSON value. Any string is retained, including the empty string; the member is not an open identifier and must be omitted rather than set to null.

value.description: JSON value carried through the erased payload envelope.

openIdentifier.description: Unicode-friendly open identifier with non-empty period-delimited segments.

jsonPrimitive.description: Primitive value represented directly by JSON.

jsonRecord.description: String-keyed JSON object whose values remain recursively JSON-compatible.
